title: Module relocation rehearsal for Audit (I19)
summary: Adds the `relocated-audit` mode to `bin/consumer-fixture.sh`: a clean application installed from the full core archive with audited data switches to a core archive without modules/audit plus a synthetic `axiomasoft/azguard-audit` archive with the same PSR-4 prefix and provider, and keeps FQCNs, commands, publish tag, migration basename, doctor result and journal rows unchanged with one autoload owner.
why: I19 rehearsal and D6/transition-policy: a future extraction must not migrate API, schema or data. Audit is the hardest slice (table, fixed basename, publish tag, two commands, plugin id, doctor check, rows). Hard risks: two autoload owners for AzGuard\Audit\ hidden by classmap order; the migration re-running because its basename or path changed; provider discovery missing in the new archive; the core archive still shipping modules/audit.

include: `bin/consumer-fixture.sh` mode `relocated-audit` exactly as p4-execution#relocation (before / relocate / after assertions, exit codes 0/1/3); reuse the archive-building code of the default and `core-only` modes
Audited panel setup for the fixture app in `fixtures/consumer/` if the existing app has none
`tests/Arch/invariants.json` I19 checks list includes the rehearsal (`bin/consumer-fixture.sh` mode `relocated-audit`)
exclude: A packages/audit directory, split configuration or Packagist step
CI wiring of the new mode (P4.5)
Any production change unless the rehearsal demonstrates a defect (convention 1)

reads.why: Rules every P4 item follows: demonstrated fixes only, stop rule for frozen contracts, 1.0 starting point, owner WIP, pushes, long runs, evidence
Exact commands, PHP 8.4 shim, driver ports, composer update rule, CI evidence procedure
Order, P4 artifacts, conditional future relocation rules
Audit migration basename, publish tag, commands and doctor audit.table
PSR-4 roots and providers removed for the relocated archive
Expected synopsis of the Audit commands

rules: Do not stage, revert or overwrite the owner's uncommitted files (p4-execution#conventions item 6); commit only the item's paths.
Writes only to build/ and a temporary directory; the repository tree is unchanged by a run.
guidance: The `core-only` mode already rewrites the core archive's composer.json (drops module roots and providers): extend that code with a 'drop only audit' variant. Build the synthetic archive with `composer archive` or zip from `packages/core/modules/audit` plus a generated composer.json. Compare journal rows with `sqlite3`/artisan tinker output hashed per row (`sha256(event_id || payload)`); keep the before/after tables in the log and in relocation.md.

validation.expect: exit 0 (3 = Packagist unreachable is a failed qualification, rerun later)
exit 0 unless a demonstrated fix is listed in fixes.md

deliverables: relocated-audit mode of the consumer fixture

result.notes: relocated-audit exit 0 in 101 s at 70c5d153 (evidence/P4/relocation.md). Grok 4.7 review round1 finding F1 (PHP backticks in the report's Audit-commands cell) fixed in aa261647. V2 (impact) ran only core-only; default and --with-filament modes not run (only the mode != full condition changed; owner-requested minimal matrix). V4: packages/** unchanged.
deviations: Relocated archives (core without modules/audit, synthetic axiomasoft/azguard-audit) carry the next patch version of --version (1.0.0 -> 1.0.1): Composer replaces an installed artifact package only for another version; a relocation is a release in reality too. Recorded by --report=FILE.
